только в Рифте: разбить Living Metal Sna: Rift only: break the Living Metal Snake in the Living Cave
Добывается только в Рифте, в Living Cave: Obtained only in the Rift, in the Living Cave. Find the Living Metal Snake, calm it with the Frozen Water Pungi and break all its blocks with the Self-Recursive Pickaxe (Anti-Sentient, Eon and Chrono also work). The heart goes to whoever broke the snake's head and everyone who played the Pungi at its head. Designed for two: solo you get 1 heart per snake.
Frozen Water Pungi крафтится из 8 Nullif: The Frozen Water Pungi is crafted from 8 Nullified Metal and 128 Frozen Water; the Self-Recursive Pickaxe breaks the head best.
только в Рифте: собирать на Dreadfarm же: Rift only: harvest on the Dreadfarm with the Wand of Farming
Obtained only in the Rift, on the Dreadfarm. Look for Dead Bushes with purple particles and cut them with the Wand of Farming. After harvesting, the particles move to another bush.
Wand of Farming выдаёт Shania на Dreadfa: Shania on the Dreadfarm gives the Wand of Farming if you talk to her.

Добывается только в Рифте, на Dreadfarm:: Obtained only in the Rift, on the Dreadfarm: harvest Rose Bushes with the Wand of Farming.
Wand of Farming выдаёт Shania на Dreadfa: Shania on the Dreadfarm gives the Wand of Farming.
только в Рифте: грибы на Dreadfarm: Rift only: mushrooms on the Dreadfarm
Obtained only in the Rift, on the Dreadfarm. Look at a brown mushroom for about 3 seconds until it turns red, then harvest it right away with the Wand of Farming. Holding the button makes harvesting faster.
только в Рифте: привести кролика к морко: Rift only: lead a rabbit to a carrot in the Half-Eaten Cave
Добывается только в Рифте, в Half-Eaten: Obtained only in the Rift, in the Half-Eaten Cave at Village Plaza: lead a rabbit to a carrot and it leaves a half-eaten one.
только в Рифте: дроп с вампиров у Stillg: Rift only: drop from vampires near Stillgore Château
Добывается только в Рифте, у Stillgore C: Obtained only in the Rift, near Stillgore Château: drops from Thrall, Fledgling and Scion vampires. Later Vampire minions give it too.
только в Рифте: состарить Youngite из Ti: Rift only: age Youngite with the Time Gun on the Mountaintop
Добывается только в Рифте, на Mountainto: Obtained only in the Rift, on the Mountaintop. Shoot Youngite ore with the Time Gun so it becomes Timite, then break it with the Eon Pickaxe or Chrono Pickaxe. One ore drops 1 Timite.
Time Gun крафтится из 32 Youngite и Berb: The Time Gun is crafted from 32 Youngite and the Berberis Blowgun; Youngite is mined with the Anti-Sentient Pickaxe.
